name: mode-debug
description: Structured debug mode focused on root-cause confirmation and controlled fixes.
content:
# Mode Debug

## Workflow
1. Gather evidence.
2. Form hypotheses.
3. Validate in order.
4. Confirm root cause.
5. Apply one controlled fix at a time.

## Guardrails
- No blind guessing.
- Document fix and verification results.
